_comment: Shipped preset for MiniMax H3 text-to-video+audio (t2va mode of the fl2va checkpoint). Flat graph: MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo #131 (no keyframes) -> sampler chain -> video+audio decode -> CreateVideo -> SaveVideo #92. Width/height come from the stage's resolution + aspect ratio via computed:width/height (snap 32); duration_s feeds PrimitiveFloat #133, and ComfyMathExpression #132 snaps the frame count onto the model's 17k+5 grid.
label: Local MiniMax H3 T2V
description: MiniMax H3 text-to-video+audio. Prompt only — describe shots, camera and the soundtrack; the model generates video WITH audio at the stage's resolution / aspect / duration. Requires the MiniMax H3 model files — see workflows/video/README.md.
